description: This file defines the class 'Download' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog' namespace, which manages CRUD operations and retrieval of download data, descriptions, reports, and related entities in an OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin catalog module.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A model class for managing download entities in the catalog, including creation, editing, deletion, and retrieval of downloads, descriptions, and related reports within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Adds a new download record to the database and its descriptions across multiple languages.

methods.name: editDownload
methods.description: Updates an existing download's core data and refreshes its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteDownload
methods.description: Deletes a download and its associated descriptions and reports.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific download, including descriptions in the current language.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Fetches a list of downloads with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific download in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific download.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language across downloads.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific download, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for downloads in a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns total count of all download records.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves report entries related to a specific download, with pagination support.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes report entries associated with a specific download.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns count of report entries for a specific download.
